FULL TEXT:
1
GOVERNMENT OF TELANGANA
OFFICE OF THE COLLECTOR AND DISTRICT MAGISTRATE, JANGAON
(Chairperson, District Child Protection Society)
Notification No.05/CH/2026 Dated: 12.10.2026
Sub: Mission Vatsalya – Government Children Home for Girls, Jangaon – Engagement of
personnel in six posts on outsourcing basis – Written examination on Sunday, the 18th
October 2026 – Notification issued.
Ref: 1. Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act 2015 and the Model Rules
2016.
2. Memo No.2062/CH/2022, dated 05.01.2023 of the Commissioner, and Memo
No.2062/CH/2022, dated 19.08.2026 of the Director, Women Development and Child
Welfare, Hyderabad.
3. Annexure I to the Memorandum of Understanding dated 24.07.2025 of the Director,
Women Development and Child Welfare, with the State level agency for the Children
Homes.
4. Notification No.02/WCD/2026, dated 05.10.2026 of the Collector, Jangaon, for
selection of the outsourcing agency.
5. Proceedings Rc.No.COLLJN/PESH/GNRL/0077/2026, dated 08.10.2026 of the
Collector, Jangaon, on the posts of the Children Home.
* * *
1. The Government Children Home for Girls, Jangaon (Balasadanam), is a Child Care
Institution for girls under the Act first cited. Six of its posts are filled on outsourcing
basis. In the reference second cited the Director has required these posts to be filled at
the district level, and they are to be filled by open selection, as ordered in the reference
fifth cited. Applications are invited from eligible women for engagement, on outsourcing
basis, in the posts shown below.
Sl.No. Post Number Who may apply Remuneration per
month
1 Counsellor 1 Women only Rs.23,170
2 Child Welfare Officer 1 Women only Rs.23,170
3 Store Keeper cum Accountant 1 Women only Rs.18,536
4 Paramedical Staff (Auxiliary Nurse
Midwife) 1 Women only Rs.11,916
5 Attender 1 Women only Rs.7,944
6 Sevika 1 Women only Rs.7,944
The Home is for girls, and all six posts are for women. The remuneration is that fixed by
the Government in the reference third cited, and any revision ordered by the Government
will apply.
COLLJN/PESH/GNRL/0077/2026-ADMINISTRATIVE OFFICER O/O DCO I/6543/2026
2
2. The qualification for each post is that laid down in the reference third cited. It will not be
relaxed. A higher qualification in the same subject is accepted in place of the degree
prescribed. The qualification shall be held on the date of this notification.
Post Qualification
Counsellor
Degree in Psychology, Counselling, Public Health, Social Work,
Sociology, Education, Food and Nutrition or Home Science, from a
recognised University; or post graduate diploma in Counselling and
Communication.
Child Welfare Officer Degree, preferably B.A. in Social Work, Sociology or Social Sciences, or
LL.B., from a recognised University.
Store Keeper cum
Accountant
Degree in Commerce, Finance or Accounting, from a recognised
University.
Paramedical Staff Pass in the course of Auxiliary Nursing and Midwifery recognised by the
Indian Nursing Council or the Telangana Nursing Council.
Attender Ability to read and write Telugu.
Sevika
No educational qualification is prescribed. The work is to assist in
housekeeping, cooking and other work as the Superintendent directs. As
the selection is by a written test in Telugu, the candidate shall be able to
read and write Telugu.
3. A candidate shall have completed 21 years and shall not have completed 44 years of age
on 01.10.2026. No age limit is prescribed for these posts in the reference third cited, and
the upper age limit of 44 years now in force for direct recruitment to posts under the
State, other than uniformed services, is adopted. It is relaxed by five years for candidates
of the Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes and Backward Classes, and by ten years for
persons with benchmark disabilities. It does not apply to persons now working in the
Home.
4. In 2023 these posts were filled from women of vulnerable categories, as stated in the
Memo of the Commissioner second cited. That preference is kept. Five marks will be
added to the total of a candidate who belongs to any of the following categories and
produces the certificate shown. Only one addition of five marks is made, even where a
candidate falls in more than one category.

3
5. Selection will be by a written examination followed, on the same day, by an oral test of
25 marks. The selection list will be declared the same day.
(a) For the posts at Sl.No.1 to 3 the written examination carries 200 objective questions
for 90 minutes, in English. Part A of 100 questions is common to these posts. Part
B of 100 questions is on the work of the post applied for.
(b) For the post at Sl.No.4 the written examination carries 100 objective questions for
60 minutes, in English and Telugu.
(c) For the posts at Sl.No.5 and 6 the written examination carries 50 objective
questions for 45 minutes, in Telugu and English, and is common to the two posts.
(d) In every paper each question has five options and carries one mark. One fourth of
a mark will be deducted for every wrong answer. Nothing is deducted for a question
left unanswered. Answers are marked on an OMR answer sheet. The syllabus is in
Annexure II.
(e) The five marks for the categories in para 4 are added to the total of the written
examination and the oral test.
(f) The key will be displayed at the venue at 12.00 noon on the day of the examination.
Objections to the key, in writing and with proof, will be received at the venue up
to 12.45 PM and decided before the result is declared.
(g) The result of the written examination will be displayed at the venue at 2.00 PM.
Candidates will be called the same day for verification of original certificates and
the oral test, in the order of marks, at three candidates for each vacancy. Every
candidate shall therefore bring all original certificates to the venue and remain there
till the result is displayed. A candidate who is absent when called, does not produce
the originals, or is found not eligible, will be passed over and the next candidate
called. No other date will be given.
(h) In the oral test each candidate will answer five questions drawn from a question
bank. Each answer will be marked out of five by the Selection Committee on a
scoring sheet, which forms part of the record.
(i) The selection list for each post will be drawn in the order of the total marks. Where
the total is equal, the candidate with more marks in the written examination, and
then the candidate older in age, will be placed higher. The list will be declared the
same evening. Orders of engagement will issue on the next day, the 19.10.2026,
for every candidate on whom the report of the Police and the certificate of medical
fitness are received. The engagement is subject to confirmation of the certificates
by the issuing authorities; where a certificate is not confirmed the engagement ends
without notice. A waiting list will be kept for one year.
COLLJN/PESH/GNRL/0077/2026-ADMINISTRATIVE OFFICER O/O DCO I/6543/2026

7. Applications in the form in Annexure I, with self attested copies of the certificates listed
in it and two passport size photographs, shall be handed over at the Inward Section of the
Collectorate, Integrated District Offices Complex, Jangaon, from 13.10.2026 to
17.10.2026, between 10.30 AM and 5.00 PM on working days and between 10.30 AM
and 1.00 PM on Saturday, the 17.10.2026. The hall ticket will be issued across the counter
on receipt of the application. Applications sent by registered post or speed post shall
reach the Collectorate by 5.00 PM on 17.10.2026, and the cover shall be superscribed
with the name of the post. Applications will not be received at the office of the District
Welfare Officer or at the Home. A candidate may apply for one post only. The written
examinations under Notifications No.04/CHL/2026, No.05/CH/2026 and
No.06/DHEW/2026 are held at the same hour on the same day, and a candidate may
apply under only one of them. There is no application fee.
8. Admission to the written examination is provisional. The venue will be announced on
the district website https://jangaon.telangana.gov.in and on the notice board of the
Collectorate by 16.10.2026. Candidates who applied by post shall collect the hall ticket
at the help desk at the venue between 8.30 AM and 9.15 AM on the day of the
examination, on production of an identity card. The candidate shall bring the hall ticket,
an identity card in original, all original certificates and a blue or black ball point pen, and
shall report by 9.00 AM. No candidate will be admitted after 9.45 AM. Mobile phones,
calculators and other electronic devices are not allowed in the examination hall.
9. The conditions of engagement are as follows.
COLLJN/PESH/GNRL/0077/2026-ADMINISTRATIVE OFFICER O/O DCO I/6543/2026
5
(a) The person selected will be engaged on outsourcing basis through the agency
selected by the Collector under Notification No.02/WCD/2026, which will pay the
remuneration and remit the contributions to EPF and ESI. The selection,
continuance and removal of the person rest with the Collector. The agency has no
part in them.
(b) The engagement is for one year at a time, and in the first instance up to 31.03.2027.
It is not service under the Government and confers no right to regularisation.
Continuance depends on the annual appraisal of performance, on the continuance
of the scheme and on the release of funds. The engagement may be ended at any
time as provided in the agreement with the agency.
(c) The Home works round the clock. The persons engaged shall work in shifts,
including at night and on holidays, as the Superintendent directs.
(d) Verification of antecedents by the Police and a certificate of medical fitness from
a Government hospital are required before engagement. Candidates called for the
oral test shall give the particulars required for the verification to the Police team at
the venue. Those selected shall appear for medical examination at the Government
General Hospital, Jangaon, at 9.00 AM on 19.10.2026.
(e) The persons engaged shall treat the girls with care and dignity, shall keep their
records confidential and shall take up no other employment. Every person engaged
is bound by section 19 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act
2012 to report any offence against a child that comes to her knowledge.
(f) Persons who have worked or are working in the Home may apply for any one post
for which they hold the qualification. No preference will be given to them beyond
what is stated in this notification.
(g) Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidate. A candidate who furnishes a
false certificate or suppresses any fact will be removed at any stage and is liable to
prosecution.
(h) No travelling allowance will be paid for attending the examination or the oral test.
10. The rule of reservation, including the reservation for persons with disabilities, and the
Telangana Public Employment (Organisation of Local Cadres and Regulation of Direct
Recruitment) Order 2018 will be followed. Each post notified is a single post in its
category. A roster is opened for each category with this selection, and each post falls at
its first point, which is open competition. Local candidates of Jangaon District, as defined
in that Order, will be selected first in the order of merit. A candidate who is not local will
be considered only where no local candidate is found eligible.
11. The Collector may modify or cancel this notification or vary the number of posts.
12. The key, results and all notices will be placed on the district website and on the notice
board of the Collectorate. No individual intimation will be sent.
COLLJN/PESH/GNRL/0077/2026-ADMINISTRATIVE OFFICER O/O DCO I/6543/2026

Counsellor

Annexure III to Notification No.05/CH/2026, dated 12.10.2026
Abridged notification for publication in the newspapers.
OFFICE OF THE COLLECTOR AND DISTRICT MAGISTRATE, JANGAON
Notification No.05/CH/2026, dated 12.10.2026
Applications are invited from women for engagement on outsourcing basis in six posts of the
Government Children Home for Girls, Jangaon, under Mission Vatsalya: Counsellor (1), Child
Welfare Officer (1), Store Keeper cum Accountant (1), Paramedical Staff (1), Attender (1) and
Sevika (1). Age: 21 to 44 years as on 01.10.2026, relaxable by five years for SC, ST and BC
and by ten years for persons with disabilities. Care leavers, orphans, single women and the
other vulnerable categories stated in the notification get five additional marks. Selection is by
a written examination with negative marking on Sunday, 18.10.2026, at 10.00 AM, with the
oral test and the result on the same day and orders of engagement on the next day. Candidates
shall bring their original certificates. Applications in the prescribed form will be received at
the Inward Section of the Collectorate, IDOC, Jangaon, from 13.10.2026 up to 5.00 PM on
17.10.2026, and hall tickets will be issued across the counter. Persons working in the Home
may also apply. The qualifications, syllabus, form of application and conditions are in the
detailed notification on https://jangaon.telangana.gov.in and on the notice board of the
Collectorate.
Collector and District Magistrate, Jangaon
COLLJN/PESH/GNRL/0077/2026-ADMINISTRATIVE OFFICER O/O DCO I/6543/2026
